trajectory_summary: This is an inbound, self-motivated lead who stayed cooperative and engaged for the entire call despite a long, clumsy bill-retrieval detour. The rep secured the booking early and handled the roofing cross-sell well, but let roughly ten minutes of dead air burn on bill-searching without pivoting to a faster alternative path, and appointment logistics (time locked) preceded actual bill capture rather than the reverse.
outcome_dispute: None on the outcome itself — a specific day and time were booked (Wednesday 5:00) — but the sequencing is notable: the appointment was locked at 07:36, well before the bill was actually captured (usage chart sent ~16:00), meaning the paid-lead bill-collection requirement was fulfilled only after the booking, not before it.
